cohort: The study included 185 Kawasaki disease (KD) patient-caregiver dyads.
finding: Maternal age was significantly associated with CAL formation and IVIG resistance in KD patients, with higher maternal age (>=32 years) linked to increased CAL risk and maternal age (>=35 years) linked to increased IVIG resistance.
mod_finding: There was no significant difference in either CAL formation or IVIG resistance in KD with regard to delivery methods.
cross-section timing: Data on perinatal factors and current Kawasaki disease outcomes were collected at the time of patient enrollment using questionnaires.
birth_weight: Birth body weight was collected, but no specific range for inclusion was mentioned.
gest_age: Gestational age at delivery was collected, but no specific range for inclusion was mentioned.
